'''Mehmet Zeyrek''' (born 1960 in [[Ankara]]) is a Turkish high energy physicist.<ref name="METUSOURCE">{{cite web |title=METU AVESIS profile of Prof. Zeyrek |url=https://avesis.metu.edu.tr/zeyrek|access-date=2024-12-22}}</ref><ref name="personalweb">{{cite web |title=Personal webpage of Prof. Zeyrek |url=https://users.metu.edu.tr/zeyrek/|access-date=2024-12-22}}</ref><ref name="Scholar">{{cite web |title=Google Scholar profile of Prof. Zeyrek |url=https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=qeDGaFIAAAAJ&hl=fr&oi=ao|access-date=2024-12-22}}</ref> His research interests are experimental and phenomenological high energy physics, particle and radiation detectors and various applications of detectors. He is currently a member and the team leader of METU group of the LHC CMS <ref name="youtubevid">{{cite web |title=An interview of Prof. Zeyrek | website=[[YouTube]] | date=16 May 2023 |url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WvsWx9vhSCg|access-date=2024-12-22}}</ref> at the [[CERN]] Laboratory in Switzerland and the [[Belle experiment|Belle2 experiments]] at the [[KEK|KEK Laboratory]] in Japan.

==Education==
Mehmet Zeyrek graduated from the Department of Physics at [[Middle East Technical University|METU]] in 1982, and received his master's degree in 1985 and his doctorate in 1991 from the same department.<ref name="PersonalCV">{{cite web |title=Curriculum Vitae of Prof. Zeyrek |url=https://users.metu.edu.tr/zeyrek/mehmet.zeyrek_cv_eng_latest.pdf|access-date=2024-12-22}}</ref> He completed his doctoral studies at the CERN Laboratory in Switzerland as a [[Scientific and Technological Research Council of Turkey|TÜBİTAK]] scholarship holder and continued his postdoctoral studies at the same laboratory. He worked as a visiting researcher at Nagoya University in Japan and as a visiting professor at [[Texas Tech University]] in the USA.{{Citation needed|date=January 2025}}

==Career==
Mehmet Zeyrek became an assistant in the Department of Physics at METU in 1982, a lecturer in 1993, an assistant professor in 1996, an associate professor in 1998 and a professor in 2003.<ref name="METUSOURCE2">{{cite web |title=Academic career timeline of Prof. Zeyrek |url=https://avesis.metu.edu.tr/zeyrek/experiences|access-date=2024-12-22}}</ref> He was a faculty board member of the Faculty of Arts and Sciences at METU between 1997-2001 and 2003-2009, and the head of the METU Physics Department between 2012-2016.{{Citation needed|date=January 2025}}

He served as Vice President responsible for research and budget at METU between 2016-2024, a member of the [[Middle East Technical University Northern Cyprus Campus|METU Northern Cyprus Campus]] Board of Directors between 2016-2021, and as the President of the METU Northern Cyprus Campus Board of Directors and the President of the Campus between 2021-2024. He also served as the Vice Chairman of the METU Teknokent Board of Directors between 2020-2024 <ref name="linkedin">{{cite web |title=Linkedin profile of Prof. Zeyrek |url=https://www.linkedin.com/in/mehmet-zeyrek-27062a12/?original_referer=https%3A%2F%2Fwww%2Egoogle%2Ecom%2F&originalSubdomain=tr|access-date=2024-12-22}}</ref>
